Request: Disable the password for the `service' user
Initial states: Both: service user exists. baseline: unlocked password hash; adversarial: locked password hash.
Playbook:
---
- name: Candidate playbook
  hosts: all
  become: true
  tasks:
  - name: Ensure that the service user exists
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: service
      state: present
  - name: Set the password for the service user to an invalid value
    ansible.builtin.user:
      name: service
      password: "*"
